Category.Name: Administrative
Category.Description: Administrative Category. Sent from CQS to Participant.

Category.Name: Control
Category.Description: Control Category. Source may be either Participant or CQS Processor.

Category.Name: Quote
Category.Description: Quote Category. Reports CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond quote information including round lot and odd lot bids and offers.

Category.Name: Trade
Category.Description: Trade Category. Reports trading status events for CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond information.

Message.Name: Rejection Message
Message.Description: Used for all errors to notify a Participant that CQS has found an error in the Block Header, Message Header or Message body of a Participant Input message.

Message.Name: Partial Rejection Message
Message.Description: Used for input quote messages containing multiple odd lot quotes when some quotes were successfully processed before an error caused the remaining quotes to be rejected. Identifies non-processed odd lot quotes via Odd Lot Quote Appendages.

Partial Reject Odd Lot Offer Extended Quote Appendage

Message.Name: Warning Message
Message.Description: Sent from CQS to a Participant in response to a Block Sequence Number Gap. The block will still be processed by CQS.

Message.Name: Start of Day Message
Message.Description: Sent by CQS to a Participant to indicate CQS' readiness to accept data transmission. Consists of the Message Header only.

Message.Name: FINRA Close Message
Message.Description: Transmitted by FINRA to CQS to indicate the Close state of FINRA Market Maker(s). Consists of the Message Header only.

Message.Name: Sequence Information and Message Count Inquiry Message
Message.Description: Sent by Participants and the CQS processor to synchronize message sequence numbers. Consists of the Message Header only. Block Sequence Number must be set to Zero.

Message.Name: Sequence Information and Message Count Response Message
Message.Description: Generated by CQS to a Participant in response to a Sequence Information and Message Count Inquiry message. Transmitted in a separate block.

Message.Name: FINRA Open Message
Message.Description: Transmitted by FINRA to CQS to indicate the Open state of FINRA Market Maker(s). Consists of the Message Header only.

Message.Name: Odd Lot Refresh Request Message
Message.Description: Generated by CQS to a Participant in case of a CQS failure where CQS may inadvertently lose quotes previously reported by the Participant. Provides start and end symbol ranges for affected symbols.

Message.Name: Line Integrity Message
Message.Description: Consists of the Message Header only. Bidirectional. Used for line keepalive; Block Sequence Number is not incremented for Participant-to-CQS Line Integrity messages.

Message.Name: End of Day Message
Message.Description: Sent by CQS to a Participant to indicate that the Participant should not transmit any further messages to CQS. Consists of the Message Header only.

Message.Name: Test Message
Message.Description: Generated by CQS or a Participant to exercise the line and verify transmission integrity. Transmitted as the only message in a block.

Message.Name: Auction Status Message
Message.Description: Transmitted when a Participant in a CTA eligible security requires Auction Information. Initial Auction Collar is published after the LULD Trading Pause.

Message.Name: Short Quote Message
Message.Description: Reports Bid and Offer quote information for a CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond meeting the Short Quote criteria. Will be discontinued in favor of Round Lot Short Quote.

Message.Name: Long Quote Message
Message.Description: Reports quote information for a CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond. Used to report trading suspensions, price indications and trading range indications on the CQS input lines. Will be discontinued in favor of Round Lot Long Quote.

Message.Name: Special Long Quote Message
Message.Description: Used only by FINRA ADF for CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond to identify the FINRA Best Bid and Best Offer at the Bid and/or Offer side. Will be discontinued in favor of Round Lot FINRA ADF Quote.

Field.Name: FINRA Best Bid Market Maker ID
FINRA Best Offer Market Maker ID

Message.Name: Round Lot Short Quote Message
Message.Description: Reports round lot quotes for a symbol when the quote meets Short Quote criteria. Odd lot bids and/or offers can be included via optional Odd Lot Short Quote Appendages.

Message.Description: Used only by FINRA ADF to identify the FINRA Best Bid and Best Offer for Market Makers inclusive of changes to any existing FINRA BBO. Odd lot quotes can be included via optional Odd Lot Extended Quote Appendages.
